data.narrative:
Comand AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Antoine Chassan, having raised €11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 10 peers across Defense & Security—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline of $12M, applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $29M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $24M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $214M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate benchmarking: Seed-stage Defense & Security companies show significant valuation variance depending on customer traction and defensibility. The peer-median method's reliance on only three comps, combined with the heterogeneous capital profiles across the sample, represents the primary analytical constraint. Revenue data and customer concentration would refine this estimate materially.
